Your reading light qualifies for a refund. The shop's records show it was received back (refund-policy/v2/return).

- **Amount:** 87.85 BRL, which is what you paid for the unit (refund-policy/v2/amount).
- **Deadline:** The 30-day limit ends at 2026-11-16 16:00 UTC. A request counts as made when the proposal is created, so yours is on time (refund-policy/v2/window).

**Next step:** Please confirm the proposal with the button on the proposal card. Typing "yes" in the chat doesn't confirm it. After you confirm, a staff member has to approve it before anything is paid (refund-policy/v2/approval).
